text: Best coffee in Seminyak, hands down. The cold brew was smooth and the staff remembered my name on day two. Will be back every morning of my trip.
Great flat white and the avocado toast is generous. Lost a star because the queue at 8am was out the door — get there early or after 10.
Worth the hype. Magic coffee (Australia-style) was excellent, beans sold by the bag. Outdoor seating only — bring a fan.
Kopi susu mereka enak, porsi croissant besar. Tempat duduk terbatas, jadi datang sebelum jam 8 kalau mau duduk di dalam.
As a Swede who takes coffee seriously: this is the only place in Seminyak that pulled a Cortado correctly. Brunch plate was generous too.
Coffee was good but the music was too loud for a morning chat. Maybe acceptable for digital nomads with headphones.
Solid espresso, friendly baristas. Cash only some days so bring rupiah just in case. Vibe is hipster-minimalist.
